title: Smooth trace
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-morphism, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Suppose $f$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ be any admissible coefficient ring: $A$ is a finite commutative ring killed by a power of $\ell$, and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. Use the small pro-etale coefficient categories and $\Dctf$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the twists of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist], and the functors and purity isomorphism of [sk-thm-purity-transport]. Here $f^!$ is the restriction of the exceptional right adjoint of [sk-prop-sf-existence].

We omit $\Lambda$ from the notation and let
$\varepsilon_f(K):Rf_!f^!K\to K$ be the counit of the adjunction
$Rf_!\dashv f^!$, restricted to $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ and $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$; it is a
morphism in $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$. For $K\in\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$, the *smooth trace*
is the composite in $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$

$$
\operatorname{Tr}_{f}(K):\quad
Rf_!\bigl(f^{*}K(d)[2d]\bigr)
\xrightarrow{\ Rf_!\gamma_{f}(K)\ }Rf_!f^!K
\xrightarrow{\ \varepsilon_{f}(K)\ }K,
$$

where $\gamma_f$ is the purity isomorphism of [sk-thm-purity-transport].
